relations.evidence: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls against any target other than the grappler.
Your Speed is 0 and can’t increase.
For example, if your Speed is reduced to 0 and you have a Climb Speed, your Climb Speed is also reduced to 0.

A.summary: The Grappled condition does three things: it sets Speed to 0 and stops it increasing, it gives Disadvantage on attacks against anyone other than the grappler, and it lets the grappler drag or carry you at a cost of 1 extra foot per foot moved, unless you are Tiny or at least two sizes smaller than t

It doesn't check the no-Disadvantage-against-grappler case, the Tiny or two-sizes-smaller exemption, Speed not increasing, or multiple grapplers
